lines: May fortune widen like the eastern sea
May your years stand firm as a mountain ridge
A gracious star keeps company at your side
And heaven quietly watches over your threshold
A round jade mirror joins two faces in one moon
Twin strings answer, brightening the room
Love finds its destined path; learning opens its gate
Together, you rise toward honor and renown
A dream comes mute, with nothing to say
A blind hand cannot thread the needle's eye
Even Confucius once went hungry on the road
Bear this silence; the hard turn will pass by
The granaries swell with more than last year's grain
No blade disturbs the laughter at the gate
Let every bowl partake of this untroubled day
Prosperity is sweetest when the whole land eats
A red leaf falls; the root still grips the ground
Even a withered branch may green again
Though stones delay the road and silver comes slow
Spring will draw your patient harvest home
A hungry tiger leaves the mountain, fierce and fast
One heedless step can turn its freedom into chains
The moth that courts another flame has learned too late
The harm we send returns to the hand that dealt it
Snow whitens the plum's dark, patient boughs
A lone fisher casts into the moonlit cold
The boat returns with no fish in its hold
Yet carries home a sky of silver light
A purple star comes down through the dark
Evil shadows shrink before its steadfast spark
When loyal hands uphold a wounded throne
A battered realm can find its strength again
A great-hearted carp lies hidden in a narrow pool
Its hour has not yet turned the current to its will
When wind joins water, bright scales break the surface
And the waiting dream rises in dragon form
The sea lies calm; even a small boat may pass
Lift the oars and let the four seasons sing
Friends raise their cups beneath the open sky
A lucky voyage begins with laughter
An old fisher's household has endured eighty years
A wise alliance can steady a troubled age
When the fields lie safe, the roads open wide
Patient service may win a kingdom's trust
One lamp answers another across the dark
Good fortune adds oil and keeps the flame alive
Even a cliffside path may hold a hidden foothold
When danger comes, seek no farther than the light at hand
A jade qilin travels softly through the night
Beneath the stars, a birth-room waits in hope
A blessed child may carry a kingdom's promise
Welcome the new light beneath your roof
A fish thrashes where the shallow waters end
Beyond the bar, the deep runs clear and strong
Do not let a troubled post make you betray your cause
Keep your honor high, though the road grows hard
Three different lives kindle one hearth
A Peach Garden oath gives iron a golden heart
The mountain jewel gleams brightest in trusted hands
With true companions, even hard days grow bright
Four friends gather where the wine cups shine
Speak the worry, then do not let it steer
Keep anger level, like a cup held carefully
Leave others' burdens; they are not yours to bear
You reach for wealth while a shadow prowls nearby
A hidden thief may covet more than what you own
Shut out disputes that have no place within your door
Prudent distance keeps the household safe
The eastern sun scatters the last cloud
Clear light pours like water through the streets
This open day rewards the hands that do things well
Begin in its brightness, and finish what you start
An iron ship meets headwinds beyond the harbor
Old grudges tangle the tide like hidden nets
Do not put the ghosts of anger at the helm
When fortune shifts, make for a trusted shore
Eight immortals cross the sea toward the peach feast
A dragon's gift stirs sharp words among the guests
An old sage lays calm between the clashing voices
Peace proves the richest gift beneath the roof
The pilgrim road runs west through dust and stone
A steadfast companion joins where the pass climbs high
Clouds seal the peaks; home fades beyond the ridge
Walk beside the friend who keeps your courage alive
Two distant stars meet once beneath the summer sky
The Silver River holds their hands apart
A glittering dream may vanish before dawn's return
Keep love in faithful time, not in a borrowed dream
An arrow chases the moon, then disappears in blue
Rotten timber will not become a palace by decree
A steady heart outlasts a thousand offerings
Build on what is sound, and let it teach you to stand
Two hearts reach across the rain between their hills
Late letters carry the ache of spring
When the season turns, the old road joins their doors
A lasting bond needs no stranger's knot
The ancient trigrams map the night with signs
A secret wrong still leaves its mark below
Lift your eyes before you take the easy shade
A clear conscience opens farther than any key
Thunder pronounces judgment across the sky
A kindly house sets lanterns by the gate
Cruel deeds grow thorns for the days ahead
Sow the good seed; let its flowering shelter all
A mantis stalks the cicada beneath the leaf
A yellow bird waits on the branch above
Do not trust the easy road or every smiling deal
Look twice before you trust; good judgment guards the heart
